title: The Intrinsic Spark

symbolism: The Page of Wands represents inspiration and creative spark—igniting passion from within. The Intrinsic Spark embodies the choice between external-motivation and intrinsic-drive. Two approaches appear: accountability-only (maintaining external-motivation avoiding intrinsic-drive) versus passion-only (relying exclusively on inspiration proving unreliability), with intrinsic-motivation integrating accountability with internal-passion.
